title: What Houston Groups Say After the Cruise
why: Proof carousel for warm leads comparing options: real Google review lines, trimmed, no staff names.
hook_options: 4.9 stars from 981 Google reviews. Here are the good lines.
We read the reviews so you don't have to.
What people say on the ride home.
caption: We went through our Google reviews and pulled the lines that tell you what the cruise is actually like. Spoiler: it's mostly about the playlist and the sunset. Real reviews, first names only. #HoustonPartyBarge #ClearLake #Kemah #HoustonBachelorette

slides.headline: 4.9 stars. 981 Google reviews.
slides.body: We pulled the lines that tell you what a cruise on Clear Lake is really like.

slides.headline: "It was a party!!"
slides.body: "As soon as we boarded, I immediately got my phone connected to the Bluetooth speaker and it was a party!!"

slides.headline: Your phone. Your playlist. From the dock.
slides.body: Every boat has a Bluetooth speaker. Whoever connects first runs the music, so decide that in the group chat.

slides.headline: "We filled the barge with ladies."
slides.body: "Music, singing, booze, bird and dolphin watching, beautiful breeze, fun, and a great crew!"

slides.headline: Dolphins happen. We can't promise them.
slides.body: Clear Lake runs out to Galveston Bay. Birds are a given. Dolphins show up on their own schedule.

slides.headline: "We could bring our own drinks."
slides.body: "We booked during sunset and it was beautiful. Definitely recommend for a good time especially if you have a large group."

slides.headline: Book the sunset slot first.
slides.body: The reviews that mention sunset all say the same thing. Those slots go before anything else does.

slides.headline: "A boat ride was a must."
slides.body: "My girls and I came into town for a trip and a boat ride was a must. We definitely plan to come again."

slides.headline: Nobody reviews the boat specs.
slides.body: They write about who they brought, what played, and what the sky did. That's the cruise.

slides.headline: Go earn your own review.
slides.body: Public cruises and private charters out of Seabrook. Save this for the group chat. houstonpedalbarge.com
